title: Publish the detour taxonomy
frozenQuestion: Does the completed E03 evidence support a graded operational taxonomy rather than one binary delayed-gratification label?
evidencePrecedence: Preserve metric-specific outcomes; adjacent descents, inversion count, Spearman footrule, and maximum rank error are not interchangeable.
Treat Spearman footrule and duplicate-aware earth mover distance as one correlated rank-transport geometry, not independent corroboration.
Keep exact n=4-9 structural-opportunity claims separate from empirical n=12-24 trajectory claims.
Do not pool effects whose supports or directions differ, including the exact-small and empirical-large barrier-removal reversal.
Keep exact impossibility, quiescence, recurrent activity, event-budget censoring, completion, residual error, and successful-run efficiency separate.
Interpret S09-S10 effects only relative to the declared intervention and common opportunity stream.
Assign each major claim exactly one strongest supported category or not_supported_in_E03.
Do not infer intention, anticipation, subjective valuation, or biological cognition from any category.

categories.minimumEvidence: A replayable accepted-action or episode record worsens a named local observable, or the paper-local proxy worsens and later recovers; independent global distance may be nonworsening or unavailable.
categories.doesNotEstablish: Global retreat, necessity, causal usefulness, policy adaptation, or a latent mental state.

categories.minimumEvidence: A replayable accepted-action or episode record increases at least one named independent global goal distance under an explicit goal projection.
categories.doesNotEstablish: Recovery, necessity, causal usefulness, or policy adaptation.

categories.minimumEvidence: A matched remove, move, activate, or add intervention from an equal pre-intervention state changes a named path, excursion, reachability, completion, residual, or cost outcome with valid intervention isolation and declared stream-coupling scope.
categories.doesNotEstablish: A uniform barrier direction, mathematical necessity, planning, or adaptation; reachability destruction and censoring remain separate outcomes.

categories.minimumEvidence: For a goal-reachable start and named metric in the frozen S05 graph, the S06 primary minimum maximum excursion over every successful legal structural-opportunity path is strictly positive.
categories.doesNotEstablish: Observed frequency, fair-scheduler probability, byte-exact replay inevitability, biological necessity, or policy adaptation.

categories.minimumEvidence: On one common support and named independent global metric: a replayable observed policy trajectory has a successful recovered global excursion; an isolated paired intervention shows that retaining the implicated worsening action or detour improves completion, residual error, or successful-run efficiency without treating intervention-created impossibility, failure truncation, or censoring as benefit; and the effect exceeds every declared feasible matched non-adaptive null under the frozen uncertainty rule.
categories.doesNotEstablish: Subjective anticipation, intention, valuation, cognition, or transfer beyond the tested simulator support.

unsupportedCategory.meaning: The asserted claim fails one or more required evidence gates or lies outside the measured support; this is not evidence of the opposite universal claim.

adaptivePassRule.nullExceedanceRule: The observed intervention contrast must be directionally favorable and its clustered 95% interval must exclude every declared feasible matched non-adaptive null contrast on the same estimand and support.
adaptivePassRule.fallback: If any gate fails, assign the strongest lower category actually supported; do not weaken the adaptive rule.

majorClaimRegistry.claim: Primary retained E01 paper-backtrack actions are local-observable backtracking events, not independent-global regressions.
The six frozen-C coverage gaps can be classified as global nonworsening.
Mixed-direction retained traces identify one consensus global goal.
A local-observable worsening can coexist with improvement under all independent global distances.
Independent-global regression is possible under an engineered wider-sensing policy on empirical larger-n support.
Exact global-metric necessary detours exist in retained small-state structural families.
The retained E01 observed trajectories execute exact necessary detours.
Barrier manipulation changes path and completion outcomes from matched exact-small starts.
Removing a barrier uniformly eliminates necessary detours or improves completion.
Suppressing every strict independent-global worsening action preserves reachability and completion.
Some strict independent-global worsening actions are structurally required and intervention-relative useful on retained exact-small supports.
Observed barrier-conditioned detours uniquely identify policy adaptation.
Open-loop and randomized feasible-action policies cannot reproduce barrier-conditioned excursions or completion.
Native empirical n=12-24 trajectories frequently regress under independent global metrics.
Native empirical n=12-24 trajectories frequently show adjacent-descent excursions while recording zero inversion, footrule, and maximum-rank excursion events.
The native larger-n zero-global-event result generalizes across wider-sensing engineered policies.
The radius-two policy creates independent-global regression on empirical larger-n support while largely removing such events on exact-labelled small starts.
Barrier-removal completion effects have one direction across exact-small and empirical-large supports.
Recent-direction memory is uniformly beneficial across exact-small and empirical-large supports.
E03 satisfies the operational adaptive-detour criteria.
Shorter failed or censored runs are more efficient than longer successful runs.
Footrule and duplicate-aware earth mover distance provide independent corroboration.

benchmarkPolicy.e07LeakageRule: Scenario identifiers and witnesses in the S14 confirmation manifest must not be used for E07 policy search, surrogate fitting, threshold selection, or prompt/model selection.

completionRule: The synthesis is supportive when every registered major claim has exactly one strongest category, every benchmark boundary has a replayable witness, all links and provenance hashes validate, the adaptive rule is applied without exception, and report inputs are complete. The substantive narrative may still be constraining.
